name: Prune: Dead Link & Duplicate Bookmark Cleaner
summary: Find dead links, duplicate bookmarks and empty folders, review everything in one list, and clean up with undo. Nothing is deleted until you say so. Free, no ads, no tracking.
description:
Prune tidies up years of bookmarks: links that no longer work, pages you saved three times, folders with nothing in them. You see everything in one review list first, and nothing changes until you confirm.

**What it finds**
- Dead links: pages that are gone (404 / 410), sites that no longer exist, links that time out or return server errors
- Links that now just send you to a site's home page (usually a removed page)
- Redirects: bookmarks whose page moved, with one click to update them to the new address (title and folder stay the same)
- Duplicates, even when the addresses differ slightly: http vs https, www, a trailing slash, or tracking junk like utm_source and fbclid
- Empty folders, including folders that only hold other empty folders

**Safe by design**
- Review list with checkboxes, filters and counts. Only clear-cut cases are ticked for you
- "Remove" moves bookmarks into a "Removed by Prune" folder instead of deleting them. Undo any change, or put items back one by one
- Emptying that folder is a separate, explicit step
- Link checks are made without your cookies, so they can't sign you out of sites or act on your accounts
- Polite checking: a time limit per site, a few links at a time and never more than two on the same site
- Pages that need a sign-in or block automated checks are shown separately, never ticked as dead

**Free, for real**
Every feature is unlocked for everyone. No ads, no account, no analytics. Your bookmarks, settings and results stay in your browser; link checks go straight from Firefox to each bookmarked site and nowhere else.

If Prune saved you some tidying and you'd like to say thanks, there's a Ko-fi link in the popup. It's entirely optional and unlocks nothing.

**Permissions**
- "Read and modify bookmarks": to find problems and move, update or restore the bookmarks you choose.
- "Access your data for all websites" is optional and only requested when you start a dead-link check, because Prune has to contact each bookmarked site to see if it still answers. You can remove it again in Settings at any time.

Desktop Firefox only: Firefox for Android doesn't give add-ons access to bookmarks.
